results.title: Metadata - Sotkanet.fi, Statistics and Indicator Bank
highlights:
# Five-year relative survival rate of breast cancer patients, % (ind. 3625)

| Data source | Years | Update frequency | Updated |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Finnish Cancer Registry | 2015–2024 | Once a year | 12.6.2026 |

## Data content

The indicator represents the five-year relative age-standardised survival rate of breast cancer patients, (0100 percent). The figure indicates the percentage of cancer patients alive five years after cancer diagnosis, compared to the percentage of the population of a similar age in the region surviving during this time. The relative survival rate can be interpreted as an estimate of the likelihood of survival in a situation where the cancer of the patient is the only possible cause of death. This is based on the monitoring of patients diagnosed during the statistical year visible on Sotkanet, and during the nine preceding years, carried out during the statistical year and the four years preceding the statistical year. The regional survival rates have been age-standardised to correspond to the age structure of the patients diagnosed in the entire country during the monitoring years.

results.title: Description of statistics and their quality - Syöpärekisteri
highlights:
The cancer statistics contain data on cancer incidence and mortality and on patients’ survival stratified by calendar year, age and sex since the year 1953. The cancer statistics are presented on a nation-wide basis and by cancer control regions and hospital districts.

...

The date and cause of death are obtained from Statistics Finland’s cause of death statistics in accordance with the official cause-of-death classification used in the corresponding year. The municipality data and survival data are updated annually from the Population Register Centre. The municipality of residence is defined as the municipality the person resided in at the beginning of the year during which the cancer was diagnosed.
